flawed_step: Step 1: the universal assertion is false; the stated hypotheses do not imply the existence of a Hamiltonian cycle.
counterexample: The Tutte graph is a finite simple 3-connected cubic planar graph with no Hamiltonian cycle.
assessment_summary: The statement is the false Tait conjecture. A standard counterexample satisfies every stated hypothesis but is non-Hamiltonian, so no proof can proceed from the definitions alone.
